name: Incredible Blow
short: Your left click: 4-target melee hit that gives back 100 MP. Opens the Resonance / Thunderbolt chain.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m and restores 100 mana.

name: Resonance Strike
short: Second hit of the left-click chain, option 1 of 2. Same 100 MP return as Incredible Blow.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m and restores 100 mana.
rank20: Nothing changes: the rank-20 dump carries an unfilled 'n' placeholder instead of a number.

name: Thunderbolt Strike
short: The other second hit of the left-click chain, and the bigger mana return: 120 MP.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m and restores 120 mana.

name: Incandescent Blow
short: Your right click: 4-target melee filler with no resource return. 2 groggy gauge.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m. Groggy gauge damage: 2.

name: Rupture Strike
short: Incandescent Blow's chain follow-up: the same 4-target melee hit, worth another 2 groggy gauge.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m. Groggy gauge damage: 2.

name: Charge Strike
short: Your gap closer: charges a target up to 20 m away, hits up to 4 enemies and gives back 100 MP.
desc: You charge a target within 20 m, deal damage to up to 4 enemies and restore 100 mana. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Impact Strike
short: Your main stun: 60% chance of 3 s (100% on NPCs). It is what sets up Wave Blow and Dark Crush.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and stuns it for 3 s with a 60% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Dark Crush
short: Only fires against a stunned, knocked-down or air-bound target. Against control-immune targets it still procs 7% of the time.
desc: Deals damage to a stunned, knocked-down or air-bound target within 20 m. Against control-immune targets it activates with a 7% chance on hit.

name: Windrage Fury
short: Only fires against a groggy target in melee: free damage during the groggy window.
desc: Deals damage to a target in the groggy state within 4 m.

name: Scorch Strike
short: Only fires on a successful block: 4-target AoE with a 40% seal for 3 s. Your reward for holding the shield up.
desc: On a successful block, deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around the target and seals them for 3 s with a 40% chance. Against NPCs the seal lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Recuperation
short: Your group heal: heals you and the party within 25 m, cleanses 1 debuff, then heals again every 2 s for 8 s.
desc: Restores health to you and to party members within 25 m and clears 1 weakening magic. For 8 s, restores health every 2 s.

name: Vibration Strike
short: Only available after an emergency evade: closes to a target within 10 m with a 50% stun. Your counter-attack.
desc: After using emergency evasion, you move to a target within 10 m, deal damage and stun it for 3 s with a 50% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Wave Blow
short: Only fires against a stunned target and knocks it down for 3 s: the second link of your control chain.
desc: Deals damage to a stunned target within 4 m and knocks it down for 3 s. Against control-immune targets it activates with a 7% chance and the animation changes. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Spin Strike
short: 4-target AoE that stacks +5% critical damage and +5% healing amplification for 30 s, up to 3 times.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a point 2 m in front of you. On hit, for 30 s your critical damage amplification goes up 5% and your healing amplification 5%. Stacks up to 3 times. Groggy gauge damage: 15.

name: Shock Release
short: Your only real cleanse: clears stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear, then 5 s of status immunity.
desc: Clears your stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear states and puts you in the Tenacious state for 5 s. Tenacious: immunity to status ailments.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 1 min to 41 s.

name: Forceful Strike
short: Shock Release's chain: a guaranteed 3 s stun on up to 4 enemies around you, right after you break a control.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around you and stuns them for 3 s.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 2 min to 1 min 22 s.

name: Blessing of Life
short: +6.5% max HP and +5% healing amplification: the passive that decides how much your heals are worth.
desc: Your max HP goes up 6.5% and your healing amplification 5%.
rank20: +35% max HP and +24% healing amplification.

name: Cross Guard
short: +200 block and HP back on every successful block: it is what makes Scorch Strike fire.
desc: Your block goes up by 200 and you restore health on a successful block. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no heal figure.

name: Protective Ward
short: Every hit stacks a ward; 10 stacks give you and the party a 10 s shield. Below 50% HP you also get a personal one.
desc: Every attack that hits gives a Protective Ward stack lasting 5 s. At 10 stacks it is consumed and gives you and your party a sacred shield for 10 s; hitting 10 again while it is up refreshes it. Separately, at 50% health or below you gain a personal shield for 5 s. Internal cooldowns: 0.5 s stacks, 1 min personal shield.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no shield figure.

name: Spell of Inspiration
short: +100 critical and +0.5% Perfect. The Perfect curve at rank 20 is what makes it worth maxing.
desc: Your critical goes up by 100 and your Perfect by 0.5%.
rank20: +290 critical and +10% Perfect.

name: Attack Readiness
short: +5.5% PvE, +2.75% PvP, +2% defence and +100 accuracy: the all-round passive, and the defence curve is huge.
desc: Your PvE damage amplification goes up 5.5%, your PvP 2.75%, your defence 2% and your accuracy by 100.
rank20: +15% PvE, +7.5% PvP, +40% defence and the same +100 accuracy.

name: Impact Hit
short: +11.2% impact-type accuracy and +0.3% Smite: the stat that makes your stuns and knockdowns actually land.
desc: Your impact-type accuracy goes up 11.2% and your Smite 0.3%.
rank20: +34% impact accuracy and +6% Smite.

name: Spell of Fury
short: Bonus damage against targets in an impact-type state or groggy: it pays off your own stun chain.
desc: When the target is in an impact-type state or groggy, you deal bonus damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Earth's Promise
short: Your attacks cut the target's PvE tolerance by 10.5% and PvP by 5.25% for 5 s. It does not stack with a Cleric's Chain of Pain.
desc: Every attack that hits cuts the target's PvE damage tolerance by 10.5% and its PvP tolerance by 5.25% for 5 s. If the target also carries a Cleric's Chain of Pain, Earth's Promise does not apply. Internal cooldown: 10 s.
rank20: -20% PvE and -10% PvP tolerance.

name: Will to Survive
short: +17% status resistance, and being controlled gives you +12% PvE / +6% PvP tolerance plus stacking resistance.
desc: Your ailment resistance goes up 17% and, when hit by stun, knockdown, air-bind, freeze or fear, you gain +12% PvE and +6% PvP damage tolerance for 5 s. While in one of those states, every hit gives +10% ailment resistance for 5 s, stacking 10 times. Internal cooldowns: 1 min tolerance, 1 s resistance.
rank20: +55% resistance and +50% PvE / +25% PvP tolerance.

name: Wind's Promise
short: On a critical, 50% chance of bonus damage to the target.
desc: On a critical hit, 50% chance to deal bonus damage to the target. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Extinguishing Flame
short: Stigma. 4-target melee AoE with a 50% knockdown and the biggest groggy contribution in the kit: 50.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m and knocks them down with a 50% chance. Against NPCs the knockdown lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 50.

name: Undefeated Mantra
short: Stigma. Party-wide +10.5% PvE damage and tolerance, +5.25% PvP. Does not stack with a Cleric's Light of Protection.
desc: Your PvE damage amplification and PvE damage tolerance, and your party's, go up 10.5%; the PvP ones, 5.25%. It does not stack with a Cleric's Light of Protection: only the higher skill level applies, and at equal level Undefeated Mantra wins.
rank20: +20% PvE and +10% PvP.

name: Focused Defense
short: Stigma. A guaranteed weapon block with +100% block damage reduction, returning 110 mana and 110 stamina.
desc: For a moment, your block damage reduction goes up 100% and you weapon-block with certainty. On a successful block you restore 110 mana and 110 stamina, once.
rank20: The block return goes from 110 to 300 mana and stamina.

name: Sprint Mantra
short: Stigma. Party-wide +10.5% movement speed, plus a 15% chance to heal on every landed attack.
desc: Your movement speed and your party's goes up 10.5% and, every time an attack hits, there is a 15% chance to restore health. Internal recovery cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: Movement speed goes from +10.5% to +20%.

name: Crushing Strike
short: Stigma. Fast charge at a target up to 20 m away, hitting 20% harder if the target is in an impact-type state.
desc: You charge quickly at a target within 20 m and deal damage. If the target is in an impact-type state, damage goes up 20%. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Marcutan's Wrath
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE that arms Dark Crush on the target for 7 s with no control needed.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away. On hit, it activates Dark Crush on that target for 7 s.

name: Blocking Power
short: Stigma. A 20 s shield blocking 3944 damage on you and every party member within 40 m.
desc: For 20 s, creates a shield on you and party members within 40 m that blocks 3944 damage.
rank20: The shield goes from 3944 to 13322 damage.

name: Binding Brand
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 50% seal for 5 s (100% on NPCs): it locks their skills.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and seals them for 5 s with a 50% chance. Against NPCs the seal lands 100% of the time.

name: Hand of Grace
short: Stigma. Instant group heal of 1171 to 1289 HP on you and the party within 25 m.
desc: Restores 1171 to 1289 health to you and to party members within 25 m.
rank20: The heal goes from 1171-1289 to 3955-4351 HP.

name: Power of the Storm
short: Stigma. 10 s of +20% combat speed and -20% skill cooldowns for you and the party within 40 m.
desc: For 10 s, your combat speed and that of party members within 40 m goes up 20% and their skill cooldowns drop 20%.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Blessing of Guardian
short: Stigma. 5 minutes of +1840 max HP, and it heals you the same 1840 instantly.
desc: For 5 minutes, your max HP goes up by 1840 and you instantly restore 1840 health.
rank20: The bonus and the heal go from 1840 to 5530 HP.

name: Assault Shock
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 30% stun that also gives you up to +20% defence, scaling with how many you hit.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and stuns them for 3 s with a 30% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Your defence goes up by as much as 20% in proportion to the number of targets hit.

name: Barrier Spell
short: Stigma. For 3 s nobody in the party within 40 m can drop below 10% HP: the raid save.
desc: For 3 s, your health and that of party members within 40 m cannot drop below 10%. Some very strong attacks cannot be blocked, and the effect is not affected by cooldown-increase effects. If you carry a non-stacking invulnerability effect, Grit, Salvation and Barrier Spell do not apply for 30 s.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 3 min to 2 min 22 s.
